description: This file defines a set of converter classes for Boolean values, including conversions to and from Integer, String, List, and Set types, within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: BooleanConverters
classes.description: Main class implementing ConverterLoader, providing methods to load various Boolean conversion utilities.

methods.name: loadConverters
methods.description: Loads contained converters for Boolean types by invoking Converters.loadContainedConverters with this class.

inner_classes.name: BooleanToInteger
inner_classes.description: Converts Boolean objects to Integer (true=>1, false=>0).

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Performs the conversion from Boolean to Integer.

inner_classes.name: BooleanToList
inner_classes.description: A singleton converter that provides a List representation of Boolean values.

inner_classes.name: BooleanToSet
inner_classes.description: A singleton converter that provides a Set representation of Boolean values.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Performs the conversion from Boolean to String.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Performs the conversion from Integer to Boolean.

inner_classes.name: StringToBoolean
inner_classes.description: Converts String to Boolean based on string equality to 'TRUE' in a case-insensitive manner.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Performs the conversion from String to Boolean.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Various convert methods transforming input objects to different types (Boolean, Integer, String).

methods.name: loadConverters
methods.description: Loads all contained converters for Boolean conversions.
